rows.behavior: kmctl init over a bundle whose .okf/decisions/ holds records with other titles (a copy of this repository's .okf/) writes no decision record and leaves every file under .okf/ byte for byte.
rows.fails_when: any new file appears under .okf/decisions/, or any file under .okf/ changes

rows.behavior: kmctl init over a .okf/decisions/ holding only index.md writes the first decision as 0001.
rows.fails_when: no 0001 record with the first decision's title is written

rows.behavior: A decision record whose front matter does not parse still counts as a record, so init writes no first decision beside it.
rows.fails_when: init writes a first decision when the only record has broken front matter

rows.behavior: The existing init tests and the rest of the suite pass under the new rule.

ADR 0011 carries a dated Correction stating the empty-folder rule and citing issue #26; the scaffold docstrings, the kmctl init epilog and docs/reference/commands.md state the new rule and none still states the title rule.
rows.fails_when: the Correction is missing, or any of those places still describes matching the first decision's title
